Do not copy any guide lines, blue outlines, gold color, dark guide background or text. Do not change the slab shape or move the box. Match the existing pixel-art stone style; no smoothing. Output ONLY the complete edited sarcophagus on true transparent background, centered with transparent margins. No ground, labels, extra props or external cast shadow.
